input.summary: Conform Vendor's audit right to once-per-12-months, 30 days' written notice, business hours, off-site, independent confidential auditor; remove unannounced remote access.
input.comment: [Playbook] We conform Section 22.1 to the audit protections already in Section 22.2: one audit per 12 months, 30 days' written notice, during business hours, off-site where possible, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, and we delete Vendor's unannounced remote access to our systems.

ops.oldText: Vendor may audit Customer at any time without notice and may remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.
ops.newText: Vendor may audit Customer no more than once every 12 months, on 30 days' written notice, during business hours, off-site where possible, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality obligations.
